description: GitLab brings project code, issues, reviews and pipelines together. Learn groups, merge requests, issue boards and checks through small worked plans with clear limits. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain use labels to organise issues
Explain plan related work with milestones
Explain make an issue board useful
learningObjectives: Practise read a ci pipeline file

seo.title: GitLab Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn GitLab with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
